title: The Clear Spring
text: A spring in a white grove, its water so clear it seems not to be there at all. Old bones lie all around it, curled up on the moss, of people who drank and stayed young. And stayed. Some of the skulls still have all their teeth, smiling.

options.label: The most weathered of you drinks from the spring.

outcomes.text: Years fall off them. They feel it in every joint, and they do not want to stop.
They want to stay. They lie down among the smiling bones, and it takes three of you to drag them away.
Clear water that never goes stale, and never quite stays still.

options.label: Leave the spring to its dead.

outcomes.text: The bones watch you go, not unkindly. The spring's chill is on you anyway, and your wounds close in it.
The bones watch you go. That night everyone dreams of drinking, and wakes thirsty.
